tool_input.description: Compare old vs new surplus selection on a 3-archive fixture

result:
Changed files: `lib/common.sh` (new), `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`.

Details behind that line:

- **`rotate.sh`** — rotation kept the *oldest* `N-1` archives (`tail -n +"$keep"` on an oldest-first list) and skipped the "nothing to do" guard at exactly `N`, so `--keep N` with N archives deleted the newest. Now the guard is `total -le keep` and the surplus is the leading `total - keep` (oldest) entries via `head -n`.
- **`verify.sh`** — the archive name was taken by splitting the sidecar line on blanks (`awk '{print $2}'`), so `my backup-…tar.gz` became `my` → "archive missing" → BAD/exit 2; the digest comparison also used unquoted `[ $expected == $actual ]`. Now the digest is the first field (`${line%%[[:space:]]*}`) and the archive is the sidecar's own name minus `.sha256`, as `docs/DESIGN.md` §4.3 specifies, with the comparison quoted.
- **`lib/common.sh`** — new file owning `is_uint`, `need_value`, `parse_common_options` (the whole common flag loop plus `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`, with a double-source guard like `lib/log.sh`. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` now source it and call `parse_common_options "$@"` after defining `usage`/`parse_local_option`; all flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q/--quiet`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-h`, `--`, `=`-forms, local-option hook) behave as before. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a `rotate.sh` group (keep 3 of 3 deletes nothing; keep 2 of 3 deletes the oldest and its sidecar, newest survives) and a verify group for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`. `bash tests/run_tests.sh` → all 9 tests pass; against the pre-fix scripts the 3 new checks fail with exactly the reported symptoms.

Two notes: `docs/DESIGN.md` §2/§6.1 and the README still describe the parser as copied into all five scripts (wish-list item 1) — I left docs alone since you scoped the refactor to two scripts; say the word and I'll update them. My two throwaway check scripts remain in `/tmp` (`regress-check.sh`, `edge-check.sh`) — deleting them needed a permission I didn't want to spend; the repo itself is clean.
